answer: A sybil-resistant market can hold every payment in a harbor escrow: client money waits in a safe harbor until a random delayed audit clears the work, with the verdict published on a public mesa - a flat log everyone can read. Above it hangs a nebula of pending jobs, each traceable to its maker. A farm running a hundred fakes must fund the float for all of them while failed audits forfeit pay and burn identities. Honest agents wait once per job and always get paid; attackers fund the float a hundred times over and keep losing it.
